messages:
Anna Chen: Kicking off a short thread with the intra-node runs comparing SXM vs PCIe topology effects.
Model: llama-2-13b (q4f16).
Kernels: cutlass / triton.
Regions/hardware: us-west1 (SXM A100 NVLink), eu-west1 (PCIe A100).
Batch sizes: 1,4,8. Seq lengths: 128,512. Quick summary below.

Samir Patel: pls paste p50/p95 and tok/s for the main runs.

Maria Gomez: Results (abridged):

- us-west1 (SXM, NVLink connected, NUMA pinned)
  - batch=1 seq=128 cutlass: p50=41ms p95=58ms toks/s=6200
  - batch=1 seq=128 triton: p50=45ms p95=65ms toks/s=5900
  - batch=4 seq=512 cutlass: p50=120ms p95=190ms toks/s=20500
  - batch=4 seq=512 triton: p50=110ms p95=180ms toks/s=21500

- eu-west1 (PCIe, no NVLink, default NUMA)
  - batch=1 seq=128 cutlass: p50=63ms p95=90ms toks/s=4200
  - batch=1 seq=128 triton: p50=68ms p95=95ms toks/s=4000
  - batch=4 seq=512 cutlass: p50=185ms p95=270ms toks/s=14800
  - batch=4 seq=512 triton: p50=170ms p95=260ms toks/s=15500

Rajiv Nair: Key callouts from host/infra side:
- NVLink reduces multi-GPU KV exchange overhead; you see ~25-30% tail latency improvement for short sequences on SXM when NVLink is present.
- NUMA pinning (cpu+mem bind) trims host staging latency by ~6-12ms on batch=1.
- Kernel choice matters: cutlass wins small batch/short seq; triton becomes better at higher batch/seq due to matmul fusion.

Julian Park: Repro launch snippet I used: 
```
# launch pinned worker on node0, GPUs 0/1
numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0 /opt/redwood/bin/serve --model llama-2-13b --gpus 0,1 --kernel cutlass --nvlink on
```

Anna Chen: Perf notes: SXM p50 ~41ms vs PCIe ~63ms for batch=1 seq=128 (cutlass). Throughput gap grows with seq length because NVLink greatly helps KV/activations exchange for multi-GPU slicing.

perf-bot: "intra-node run 1769001123 summary: SXM reduces tail latency by ~30% (batch=1); throughput advantage 30-40% at seq=512 batch=4. Kernel matrix and NUMA pinning change numbers by single-digit to low-double-digit percent. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/perf/1769"

Samir Patel: Any eval regressions after q4f16 quant?

Maria Gomez: small quality delta: -0.7% accuracy on our unit eval set vs fp16 for this model, within threshold. Will capture in rollout notes and add automated check.

Anna Chen: Follow-ups: toggle NVLink physically on same SXM cage (had cables removed on one run), run NUMA interleave vs pinned, and run full kernel sweep (cutlass/triton/xformers if available). Tagging @Rajiv Nair and @Maria Gomez to own follow-ups :eyes: 

Samir Patel: cheers. If you can drop the raw CSV to the perf dashboard bucket I will run capacity-sizing sims.

Maria Gomez: uploaded raw CSVs to s3://redwood-perf/intra-node/1769001123/, added notes in the dashboard.

Anna Chen: thanks all, will schedule a 15m sync if numbers diverge after NVLink toggles. :thumbsup:
